title: Level 60 is glitched and has been for years
content:
The game starts fun but after only a couple levels becomes absurdly difficult. This is not a skill issue, this is Rovio trying to get people to buy microtransactions. 

You can just barely squeak by getting single stars at points and other levels are pretty easy. But you can tell the intricacy of the levels and amount of pigs that Rovio are being manipulative in getting people to get frustrated.

Not to mention the bugs. Some levels have a certain amount of randomness by design. But when things don’t spawn the same way every time you get slightly but noticeably different runs.

It’s fun at first but then you notice how greedy and scummy Rovio is.

It’s a free game but it’s designed to scam kids and people unaware of how it slowly nags at you to buy things, and then gets so difficult you have to spend money. Why make a game that’s fun for a $1 or $5 when you can make money off whales right Rovio? 

Also in my title level 60 is impossible without RNG or purchases due to the level being bugged. I can see why this game is dogged on now.
summary: Game becomes absurdly difficult quickly, with bugs and perceived manipulation to push microtransaction spending.

title: Absolute scam of the year
content: This game has a game within it called Blues Tower.  The concept is simple.  Every day you reach a new level, you climb a floor.  Every two weeks, when you reach, let’s say, Floor 615, you get rewards and you strive to reach the next Floor level goal, another two weeks later.  However, this game is rigged.  You don’t progress each day.  You play, and you don’t progress to the next floor.  Or…better yet…the game “allows” you to go up a floor towards your next Floor goal that’ll give you a reward at the end, but suddenly you’re back at Floor 602 and need to work yourself back up to Floor 615.  But you never get there.  You never make any progress.  So what should take you two weeks to reach the next Floor level and gain points will actually take you months.  I would never pay for a game that cheats its players.
summary: Blues Tower progress resets unexpectedly, making the reward system feel rigged and broken.

title: scam
content: This could be a fun game if it wasn’t such a blatant cash grab. They have tournaments and one-on-one play that you often can’t even be competitive in or sometimes even finish without spending on power ups, and the rewards you get for winning are meager. They’ll let you watch ads for power ups when you already have power ups but once you actually need them that option disappears forcing you to buy them, and literally every single time you try and navigate the Home Screen you are bombarded with popups trying to force you to purchase their stuff. They do have a way for you to earn powerups but I’m pretty sure the games are rigged and if you actually want any substantive rewards they force you to keep betting double-or-nothing and by the time you’re actually in a position to get a good reward your opponent mysteriously gets a whole bunch of points at the last minute forcing you to (guess what?!) buy power ups. Complete scam.

content: While playing BLUES TOWER and playing level 299, right before I would have played one more level for 600 coins, the game glitched on me and I screen recorded it going in and out but not closing the game hoping it would figure itself out, then finally had to shut down. I lost my place after weeks of not spending money to finally get to the next save level, I had to close out and it bounced me back 13 levels. I have played this game for far too long for this to happen. Too many times this game has glitched in certain ways that has made me lose levels but not make me miss out on 600 coins and anyone knows that playing this, 600 extra coins can get you a long way. After having this app since 2015, almost 10 years, it’s time for me to quit and say goodbye. Game has been going on for far too long to continue to have portal glitches or game glitches that knock you down from losing slightly bigger pots of coins. title: Slowly taking more away from the player
content:
I have been playing this game for many, many, MANY years.  It has been a ton of fun.  But, over time, the player/customer is not as important.   This is becoming more and more frustrating.

1.   We get a free spin every four hours.   Why is this not something counted inside the app and has to have 100% internet connection?   Have had times where it was after four hours, and it now says “offline” so we don’t get a free spin unless we connect to the internet whenever we are….  This wheel needs to be not 100% internet dependent.  Never used to be, why it is now, no clue…

2.   There are fewer chance of winning awards/boosts.  Used to get two or three of them a few times a day after watching ads on each.  Only get one attempt only twice a day.  Same with spinning the wheel, but it’s even more frustrating to watch an ad and have the wheel go to the one where you win nothing.  Again, customer is not as important as it used to be.  

3.  They have ad providers who not only have long ads, but it’s hard to get out of them.   There’s not just a long countdown after watching the ad; they make you do it TWICE!  You hit the x after it counts down, but instead of it taking you out of the ad, it makes you wait again on a second screen an additional 5 seconds or so before you can get out of it.  A few times, I’ve had this not only take that long to get out, but it doesn’t show you winning a prize; it feels like you watched an ad and earned nothing!  But, the fact that these ad providers make you stuck in their ads is not customer service, and the fact that I don’t have this issue in other games that involve ads is on the game maker, not on the customer.  

4.  Ran into issues multiple times that I can’t pause or reset a level while a bird is in the air.  If it doesn’t have a power that you tap to make it do something, it’s hung until the bird hits something.  Very frustrating that if you do something wrong, you have to wait multiple seconds to pause and restart the level.

Again, I feel like the customer isn’t the priority; this is around because people want to play this game.   Don’t do things that gets in the way of the person playing this game like we used to.
summary: Long-time player frustrated by fewer rewards, internet-dependent spin wheel, and overall reduction in player-friendly features over time.

title: Love this AB competition
content:
I have played this game since day one, and love it so much. So why the 1 star? Because Rovio have got so greedy I can no longer afford to play it. As it’s a competition against friends and strangers, you can only compete by having power-ups. The only bundle worth buying costs £75 (now increased to £99). That used to last me a couple of months, now it lasts just ‘two weeks’. Firstly there were  12 levels a week, this then increased to 18, then to 24 levels. Then a boom box was added, but the game was still affordable. Now, they’ve added extra power-ups to each level. To play this game and to be able to compete it’ll cost you around £150 a month! Even with friends gifting (Max 30 a day) it still requires a lot of money. And this during lockdown is even more of a kick in the teeth.

I’m so sad as I look forwards to this game three times a week, but will be uninstalled and I’ll go ‘cold turkey’!

title: I love Angry Birds, but…
content:
I first installed this game a couple of years ago on another device and I still love playing it on an almost daily basis. There‘s just so much stress relieve in killing those happy little pigs. ;-)

That being said, there are two points that made me take away one star from the five available. Firstly, the ads: I know it’s a free game. It’s absolutely understandable to me that the creators want to make money off the game one way or another. You can do in-app purchases or, if you don’t want to spend any money like me, watch ads instead. However, the length of one ad alone is absolutely ridiculous sometimes. Most of them are 30 seconds long. My personal record was a recent one that lasted a minute. A lot of the time you have to click a couple of ‚x‘ and at least one pop-up window away, before you can continue playing the game. The content of the ads sometimes doesn’t reflect the fact that children play this game as well. Finally, and that’s my last complaint about the ads, there are a lot of ads for SHEIN, a company that personally I find evil. I don’t want to see that. And I don’t understand how Angry Birds can do game tournaments on climate change awareness on the one hand and show ads like that on the other hand.

The second point that made me take away that one star is a technical glitch that I’ve been experiencing since I connected the game to my fb. Ever since then it’s not working properly anymore. Since there have been technical problems and hiccups in the past that have been resolved in the meantime, I remain hopeful though that this one will be resolved someday soon, too. I’ll continue enjoying to play Angry Birds Friends for so long.
summary: Long-time player enjoys the game but finds individual ad lengths far too long.

title: Sehr enttäuschend!

In den Tunieren ist es sehr sehr schwer in die Top 20 zu kommen und das auch nur wenn man mit Items das komplette Level leer räumt. Kommt man hoch genug wird man mit Gold belohnt, was aber noch lange nicht reicht die Items zu kaufen die man braucht. Wer ganz ohne Items spielt (so wie ich eigentlich) hat da überhaupt keine Chance. Mit Angry Birds 2 will ich gar nicht anfangen… einfach nur Abzocke. Mit Angry Birds Reloaded habt ihr wieder alles richtig gemacht. Leider werde ich trotz Riesen Fan nur 2 Sterne vergeben… einfach aus dem Grund, dass das Spielprinzip und die Charaktere einfach nur Genial sind… ihr aber nicht wirklich was draus macht außer bei den Spieler abzukassieren. Ich gehöre noch der älteren Generation an die sich nicht so gutgläubig abzocken lässt. Früher hättet ihr keinen Cent (Pfennig) verdient… von wegen InApp Käufe, Werbung etc. Echt traurig was aus der Welt geworden ist.

Eine Frage hätte ich noch gerne gewusst… wieso gibt es die ganzen Angry Birds Spiele nicht mehr im Store?

title: Die Verbindungsaufbauzeiten

sind fern jeder Realität - egal ob WLAN, LTE oder 3G. Dadurch wird der Akku schnell leer gezogen. So macht das trotz FB-Account keinen Spaß. Daher nur einen Stern.

Update 24.05.3017
Beim Star Cup bricht teilweise die Verbindung ab und wenn der Sperrbildschirm aktiviert war, erfolgt die Darstellung im halben Display hochkant. In beiden Fällen ist das Ticket weg.

Bei der Umschaltung vom Star Cup zu Angry Birds Friends ist automatisch die Holzschleuder eingestellt, unabhängig von der vorher genutzten.

Kurioserweise erfolgt bei Angry Birds Friends nach dem Erreichen eines neuen Highscore oft ein Verbindungsabbruch, so dass nur "Saving..." (WLAN oder LTE) steht und nur ein Neustart der App Abhilfe schafft. Der Highscore ist dann futsch. Ein Schelm ist, wer Böses dabei denkt.

Update 13.06.2017
Spielt man im Starcup und legt das Telefon im Querformat flach auf den Tisch und dabei schaltet sich die Sperre ein, so erscheint bei Freischaltung nur ein halber Bildschirm. Die App muss komplett neu gestartet werden. Damit sind die Tickets aus dem Starcup futsch.

The game itself is excellent. I love playing it. But Rovio's server is, at least, a piece of crap. It doesn't sync properly, there are constant connection crashes where I lose progress, I watch the ads to get power ups and they don't come even after watching all of it, I simply CANNOT gift using the app. It is impossible. 

I've tried the game on different iPads, on different connections.. it just doesn't change. 

It's a shame because I really like the game.
summary: Server sync failures, connection crashes, missing ad rewards, and broken gifting ruin an otherwise enjoyable game.
